issues.description: Console warning: container has non-static position for scroll offset calculation. Not visible to user but indicates a positioning issue in a component.
issues.root_cause: A component (likely a dropdown or scroll container) is missing a relative/fixed/absolute position style, logged in console but not causing visible UI issues.

issues.description: A 400 status resource failed to load once in console logs - likely a transient network request (possibly Google OAuth config check or analytics) that does not affect visible UI.
issues.root_cause: A fetch/XHR request to an external or local endpoint returned HTTP 400. Could be a Google OAuth client ID misconfiguration or an API preflight check.
